Repeated procedure that should be a skill
Missing specialty (root or lead does lookups itself)
Wrong reporting line (analyst under the build lead)
Role lacks a write tool it needs

gaps.label: Repeated procedure that should be a skill
gaps.mechanism: the hybrid strategy drafts a skill (created disabled; a person turns it on), or the skills suggestion flow
gaps.blocker: synthesizer.ts fromFindings: skill_crystallization is a note on the deterministic strategy; service.ts planFor drops new skills without the skills.setEnabled port (the host wires none: bootstrap.ts), and grants to the new skill are never added by a plan.

gaps.label: Ceremonial layer (coordinator with one report)
gaps.mechanism: propose_org_change in a work run or the Architect retrospective (a person approves the new chart)
gaps.blocker: synthesizer.ts fromFindings turns ceremonial_layer into a note only; ratchet.ts chartProblems rejects any change to reportsTo, spawnable or the role set (chart_broken), so no evolve strategy can remove a layer.

gaps.label: Role lacks a write tool it needs
gaps.mechanism: a person, propose_org_change in a work run, or the Architect retrospective
gaps.blocker: synthesizer.ts fromFindings adds only Read, Glob and Grep; ratchet.ts validateEvolutionPlan rejects the whole plan for any write or exec tool (write_tool_added / write_tool_to_readonly), also from the hybrid model.

gaps.label: Missing specialty (root or lead does lookups itself)
gaps.mechanism: propose_org_change in a work run or the Architect retrospective
gaps.blocker: telemetry.ts diagnose skips the root agent (isRoot) and has no finding for work a spawner does itself; ratchet.ts chartProblems rejects adding a role (chart_broken).

gaps.label: Guard role (reviewer) on deep
gaps.mechanism: deterministic evolve if the review work were short; otherwise a person
gaps.blocker: telemetry.ts diagnose: the over-provisioned rule needs short work (avg turns <= 6, output <= 4,000); a review of 9 turns never qualifies, so cost waste on long-work roles is invisible. Note the gate does NOT protect a guard role's tier (only its prompt, tool removals and skills).

gaps.label: Tier under-provisioned (builder on everyday)
gaps.mechanism: interactive `orgai org evolve --apply` with a person approving the raise (two generations), the hybrid strategy with approval, propose_org_change in a work run, or the Architect retrospective
gaps.blocker: service.ts applyCore: the post-run pass never sets allowSpendRaise, so spend.ts holdSpendRaises strips every raise (rule spend_held). Even approved, synthesizer.ts fromFindings first proposes `staffing.minTier = current tier` (a floor equal to the ceiling, which changes nothing under goal balanced: runtime/staffing.ts resolveStaffing already runs at the ceiling); only the next generation raises the tier.

gaps.label: Tier over-provisioned (lookup role on deep)
gaps.blocker: telemetry.ts diagnose: the over-provisioned rule stops at everyday when effort is low (`!(runtimeTier === 'everyday' && role.effort === 'low')`) and never fires on fast; synthesizer.ts fromFindings steps one tier per generation and service.ts cooldownOf holds the role for COOLDOWN_RUNS (5) runs after each decision.

gaps.label: Merge conflict hotspot (overlapping file scopes)
gaps.mechanism: deterministic evolve treats the symptom (the fixed file-scope block in the spawner's prompt); the overlapping scope lines themselves only by hand or propose_org_change
gaps.blocker: ratchet.ts validateEvolutionPlan accepts a prompt patch only as compressPrompt output or the fixed SCOPE block on the conflict's lead (prompt_not_subset), so the builders' own scope lines are never edited.

gaps.label: Wrong reporting line (analyst under the build lead)
gaps.mechanism: propose_org_change in a work run or the Architect retrospective
gaps.blocker: telemetry.ts diagnose has no finding for "spawned through the wrong lead"; plain re-spawns (staffing source role) are counted as first passes; ratchet.ts chartProblems rejects reportsTo and spawnable changes (chart_broken).

gaps.label: Guard role (reviewer) prompt bloat
gaps.mechanism: a person or the Architect retrospective (by design)
gaps.blocker: plan.ts isGuardRole protects review/verify/QA/audit/security/test roles; synthesizer.ts fromFindings notes it and ratchet.ts validateEvolutionPlan trims any prompt change (prompt_protected).

gaps.label: Redundant role never used
gaps.mechanism: the Architect retrospective or a person; nothing measures an unused role
gaps.blocker: telemetry.ts diagnose aggregates only agents that ran, so a role never spawned has no finding (unless its prompt passes 900 characters); ratchet.ts chartProblems rejects removing a role (chart_broken).

gaps.label: Serial bottleneck (concurrency 1)
gaps.mechanism: interactive `orgai org evolve --apply` with a person approving the concurrency raise
gaps.blocker: spend.ts spendRaisesOf counts a higher concurrency limit as a raise; service.ts applyCore holds it on the post-run pass (spend_held). telemetry.ts spawnShape also reads only the ROOT's direct reports, so a chart whose leads fan out is measured on the leads, not the workers.

gaps.label: Tool friction (lookup role lacks Grep)
gaps.mechanism: deterministic evolve (adds Read, Glob or Grep)

gaps.label: Effort too high (simple-work role on high)
gaps.mechanism: deterministic evolve on everyday/deep roles; nothing on a fast role
gaps.blocker: telemetry.ts diagnose: the over-provisioned rule requires `tierDown(runtimeTier)` (deep or everyday), so effort waste on a fast role is never a finding; on an everyday role it fires only for short work (avg turns <= 6 and output <= 4,000 tokens).
